summary.zh: 评估 RFP 缺口、竞品对比与 POC 计划
summary.en: Finds RFP gaps, compares features and plans a POC

description.zh: 面向售前工作：检查投标应答是否覆盖客户要求，整理与竞品的功能对比矩阵，并规划概念验证的范围和评分方式。适合在应标、竞标或给客户安排试用方案时使用。
description.en: Supports pre-sales work: checks RFP responses for coverage gaps, builds competitive feature matrices, and plans and scores a proof of concept. Useful when responding to tenders or setting up a customer trial.
